name: LitchiPestDisease
description: The litchi industry has long been severely plagued by the litchi fruit borer ( Conopomorpha sinensis ) and litchi anthracnose ( Colletotrichum gloeosporioides ). Despite the rapid development of deep learning in agricultural monitoring, there is currently no public dataset that supports the simultaneous detection of these two stresses, let alone a systematic simulation of variable lighting conditions in real postharvest environments. To address this issue, we constructed LitchiPestDisease—the first multi-illumination image dataset dedicated to the detection of litchi fruit borer infestation and litchi anthracnose. This dataset contains images collected from the core production areas in Maoming, Guangdong, China, during 2024 and 2025. To support the simulation of realistic grading scenarios, the dataset includes the original images and three systematically enhanced illumination variants (front lighting, back lighting, and side lighting) generated following the protocol described in this paper. All these images are provided in the public repository. The pest subset includes 3,061 original images, all annotated with bounding boxes for borer damage holes. The disease subset consists of 3,644 original images, a portion of which are additionally annotated with polygon instance segmentation, where each lesion is labeled by its severity (mild, moderate, severe). The corresponding enhanced images under three lighting conditions are fully provided in the public repository.
